title: 第一卷 第27章 在她面前是小奶狗

第一卷 第27章 在她面前是小奶狗-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》

不过瞿爽转念一想，再失控能如何？板上钉钉的证据能飞了不成？只要从上官程口袋里搜出那几块矿标，他的嫌疑就别想剔除！

这么想着，她的神色又渐渐安定下来。继续摆出不可一世的模样。

酒安把章峰的同事拉到一旁，三两句问完了前因后果，不耐烦地啧了一声：“我当多大点事儿，原来就是丢了几块石头。搜身是吧？”

他对那个跟班说：“你现在叫两个女同事过来搜女生，我先把那男生搜了。”

说罢，大步流星朝上官程走去。

霖多多这次是真不敢拦了，只能抿着嘴唇默默祈祷：千万别发现阿九是机器人，千万别……

酒安路过瞿爽身边的时候，不知是有意还是无意，那铁塔般的身躯猛地一歪，肩膀结结实实撞在了瞿爽身上。

瞿爽那小身板哪经得起这一撞？七厘米的细高跟“咔嚓”一歪，她“啊——”地尖叫一声，整个人朝旁边摔了出去。一只高跟鞋甩飞了出去，那只价格不菲的小挎包也扣翻在地。

“不好意思！”酒安忙道，“这过道太窄了，没注意，我帮你捡！”他一边说，一边去拾那只精致的小包。可动作粗笨，反倒把包里的东西全洒落了出来。

“诶？！”

彭源忽然瞪大了眼睛，手指着地上，声音都劈了：“这……这不是教授的那块祖母绿吗？！”

霖多多和汪教授闻言凑过去一看，双双瞪大了眼。

霖多多：“那盒眼影下面压着的，好像是那块粉色萤石啊！还有滚到桌角那边的——是孔雀石吧？”

酒安“哦？”了一声，脸上的表情从“不好意思”变成了“有点意思”。

“难道这就是那几块丢的石头？”他直起腰，不紧不慢地从口袋里掏出一副手套戴上，蹲下身，把矿标一块一块捡起来，收进证据袋，递给汪潇。

汪教授接过袋子，翻来覆去看了几眼，一脸复杂地点了点头：“没错，就是这三块。”

彭源也凑过来看，然后一脸鄙夷地看着瞿爽：“某些人，口口声声说别人偷东西，结果东西从她自己包里翻出来了。贼喊捉贼，也不过如此吧。”

汪教授深吸一口气，摘下眼镜擦了擦，又重新戴上。他看着瞿爽，目光里是不加掩饰的失望。

“瞿爽，这件事我会跟你父亲沟通的。矿标本是教学科研所用，你若喜欢，可以跟我说，不必用这种方式。”

瞿爽从刚刚看到矿标的刹那便已经僵愣住了。她盯着那三块石头，像在看三只从地狱里爬出来的恶鬼。脸色从红变白，从白变青。

But Qu Shuang then thought about it, what if he loses control again?Can the conclusive evidence be released?As long as those few mining signs are found in Shangguan Cheng's pocket, his suspicion will be eliminated!

Thinking this way, her expression gradually calmed down again.Continue to act arrogant.

Jiu An pulled Zhang Feng's colleague aside, asked a few questions about the cause and effect, and clicked his tongue impatiently: "I don't think it's serious, it turns out that I just lost a few stones. Searched me, right?"

He said to the attendant: "Now ask two female colleagues to come over and search for girls. I will search for the boys first."

After that, he strode towards Shangguan Cheng.

Lin Duoduo really didn't dare to stop him this time. He could only purse his lips and pray silently: Don't find out that Ah Jiu is a robot, don't...

When Jiu An passed by Qu Shuang, whether intentionally or unintentionally, his iron tower-like body suddenly tilted, and his shoulder bumped into Qu Shuang's body firmly.

How could Qu Shuang's small body withstand this collision?The seven-centimeter stiletto heel clicked, and she screamed "Ah--" and fell sideways.One high-heeled shoe flew out, and the expensive small satchel fell to the ground.

"Sorry!" Jiu An said hurriedly, "The aisle is too narrow. I didn't pay attention. I'll help you pick it up!" He said while picking up the delicate little bag.But the movement was clumsy and all the contents of the bag spilled out.

"Eh?!"

Peng Yuan's eyes suddenly widened, and he pointed at the ground, his voice cracking: "This...isn't this the professor's emerald?!"

Lin Duoduo and Professor Wang heard this and leaned over to take a look, their eyes widened.

Lin Duoduo: "The thing underneath that box of eye shadow seems to be the pink fluorite! And the one that rolled to the corner of the table - is it malachite?"

Jiu An said "Oh?" and the expression on his face changed from "sorry" to "a little bit interesting".

"Could these be the few stones that were thrown away?" He straightened up, took out a pair of gloves from his pocket and put them on, squatted down, picked up the mining signs one by one, put them into the evidence bag, and handed them to Wang Xiao.

Professor Wang took the bag, looked over it a few times, and nodded with a complicated look on his face: "Yes, these are the three pieces."

Peng Yuan also came over to take a look, and then looked at Qu Shuang with disdain: "Some people keep saying that others steal things, but in the end the things are turned out of their own bags. A thief's cry to catch a thief is nothing more than that."

Professor Wang took a deep breath, took off his glasses, wiped them, and put them back on.He looked at Qu Shuang with undisguised disappointment in his eyes.

"Qu Shuang, I will communicate with your father about this matter. Mineral specimens are for teaching and scientific research. If you like them, you can tell me. There is no need to use this method."

Qu Shuang was stunned from the moment he saw the mine sign.She stared at the three stones as if she were looking at three evil spirits crawling out of hell.The face changes from red to white, from white to blue.
